### Q38. What is the main goal of palliative care?

Source bank Q1.

- **A.** Avoid discussions about patient preferences
- **B.** Improve quality of life by addressing symptoms and psychosocial needs alongside appropriate treatment
- **C.** Stop every disease-directed treatment at diagnosis
- **D.** Provide only care during the final hours of life

<details><summary>Answer aur explanation dekho</summary>

**Correct: B. Improve quality of life by addressing symptoms and psychosocial needs alongside appropriate treatment**

**A kyun galat hai:** Patient ki wishes samajhna zaroori hai, kyunki unhi se care ke goals decide hote hain. Nurse discussion ko avoid nahi karti.

**B kyun sahi hai:** Palliative care mein serious illness ke saath jee rahe patient ki takleef kam karne aur quality of life behtar banane par focus hota hai. Nurse pain, breathlessness, emotional aur spiritual needs assess karti hai aur team ke saath appropriate care arrange karti hai.

**C kyun galat hai:** Palliative care shuru hone par har disease-directed treatment ko band karna zaroori nahi hai. Jo treatment patient ke goals aur clinical needs se match karta hai, woh jaari reh sakta hai.

**D kyun galat hai:** Palliative care illness ke earlier phase mein bhi shuru ho sakti hai. Sirf final hours tak wait karne se patient ko pehle mil sakne wala symptom relief nahi milta.

**Exam clue:** Palliative care aur disease-directed treatment ek saath chal sakte hain.

**Evidence and links:** Preserve the current mock metadata and references. Review source-bank evidence for appropriate qualified propagation only after coordination.

</details>

### Q48. Which response is most therapeutic when a newly bereaved person begins crying?

Source bank Q3.

- **A.** Remain present, acknowledge the loss and allow expression of grief
- **B.** Tell the person to stop crying
- **C.** Immediately change the subject
- **D.** Insist that grief must end within a week

<details><summary>Answer aur explanation dekho</summary>

**Correct: A. Remain present, acknowledge the loss and allow expression of grief**

**A kyun sahi hai:** Kisi apne ki death ke baad rona grief express karne ka natural tareeka ho sakta hai. Nurse shaant rehkar saath baithti hai, loss acknowledge karti hai aur person ko apni pace par bolne ya chup rehne deti hai.

**B kyun galat hai:** Rona rokne ko kehne se person ko lag sakta hai ki uski feelings galat hain. Feelings ko respect karna zyada supportive hai.

**C kyun galat hai:** Topic turant badalne se person ki baat adhuri reh jaati hai. Nurse ko sensitive listening ka mauka dena chahiye.

**D kyun galat hai:** Grief khatam hone ki koi universal deadline nahi hoti. Ek hafte ki limit lagane se person apni feelings chhupane lag sakta hai.

**Exam clue:** Therapeutic response mein loss acknowledge karo aur bina judgment ke suno.

**Evidence and links:** Preserve the current mock metadata and references. Review source-bank evidence for appropriate qualified propagation only after coordination.

</details>

### Q97. A patient with advanced illness says that maintaining alertness matters more than complete pain relief. What should the nurse do?

Source bank Q2.

- **A.** Explore this preference and communicate it for an individualized symptom plan
- **B.** Withhold all comfort measures permanently
- **C.** Tell the patient there is only one acceptable goal
- **D.** Choose the highest sedating dose regardless of the preference

<details><summary>Answer aur explanation dekho</summary>

**Correct: A. Explore this preference and communicate it for an individualized symptom plan**

**A kyun sahi hai:** Patient alert rehkar family se baat karna chahta ho sakta hai. Nurse pain aur sedation assess karti hai, preference document karti hai aur prescriber ke saath comfort aur alertness ka individualized balance discuss karti hai.

**B kyun galat hai:** Saare comfort measures band karne se avoidable suffering ho sakti hai. Pain relief ke doosre options aur dose review abhi bhi possible hain.

**C kyun galat hai:** Har patient ki priorities alag ho sakti hain. Nurse ko apna goal impose karne ki jagah patient ka informed preference samajhna chahiye.

**D kyun galat hai:** Bina assessment ya authorized prescription ke sedating dose badhana unsafe hai. Isse patient ki consciousness aur breathing affect ho sakti hai.

**Exam clue:** Symptom relief ka plan patient ki priorities ke according individualize karo.

**Evidence and links:** Preserve the current mock metadata and references. Review source-bank evidence for appropriate qualified propagation only after coordination.

</details>

### Q100. A family member feels angry and sad at different times after a death. What explanation is accurate?

Source bank Q4.

- **A.** Anger always proves a psychiatric disorder
- **B.** All people must progress through grief stages in one exact order
- **C.** Grief responses may fluctuate and need not follow a fixed sequence
- **D.** Sadness after death is abnormal in every case

<details><summary>Answer aur explanation dekho</summary>

**Correct: C. Grief responses may fluctuate and need not follow a fixed sequence**

**A kyun galat hai:** Anger akela psychiatric disorder ka proof nahi hai. Severe persistent distress, functioning ki dikkat ya safety concern ho toh further assessment zaroori hai.

**B kyun galat hai:** Kübler-Ross model exam mein poochha ja sakta hai, lekin real life mein har person usi sequence se nahi guzarta. Model ko fixed clinical timetable nahi samajhna chahiye.

**C kyun sahi hai:** Grief ke dauran sadness, anger aur doosre emotions badal sakte hain ya dobara aa sakte hain. Har person ka experience alag hota hai. Nurse coping, functioning aur safety needs assess karti hai.

**D kyun galat hai:** Death ke baad sadness normal grief ka part ho sakti hai. Sirf sadness dekhkar disorder diagnose nahi karte.

**Exam clue:** Grief stages ek possible model hain, compulsory sequence nahi.

**Evidence and links:** Preserve the current mock metadata and references. Review source-bank evidence for appropriate qualified propagation only after coordination.

</details>

### Q43. Which term describes grief occurring before an expected loss, such as anticipated death from advanced illness?

Source bank Q5.

- **A.** Anticipatory grief
- **B.** Absence of grief
- **C.** Disenfranchised grief by definition
- **D.** Complicated grief in every case

<details><summary>Answer aur explanation dekho</summary>

**Correct: A. Anticipatory grief**

**A kyun sahi hai:** Anticipatory grief tab ho sakta hai jab loss abhi hua nahi hai, lekin person ko uske hone ki expectation hai. Jaise advanced illness mein family future separation ke baare mein dukhi ho sakti hai. Nurse feelings sun kar preparation aur support mein madad karti hai.

**B kyun galat hai:** Loss hone se pehle bhi sadness, fear ya worry ho sakti hai. Isliye death abhi nahi hui hai, iska matlab grief absent nahi hai.

**C kyun galat hai:** Disenfranchised grief aisa grief hai jise society ya aas-paas ke log recognize ya support nahi karte. Iska defining feature loss se pehle hona nahi hai.

**D kyun galat hai:** Expected loss par dukhi hona apne aap mein disorder nahi hai. Persistent severe distress aur functioning ki dikkat ka alag assessment hota hai.

**Exam clue:** Anticipatory ka matlab expected future loss se juda grief hai.

**Evidence and links:** Preserve the current mock metadata and references. Review source-bank evidence for appropriate qualified propagation only after coordination.

</details>

### Q51. A dying patient has dry mouth, limited oral intake and an aspiration risk. Which comfort measure is appropriate?

Source bank Q6.

- **A.** Provide frequent safe oral and lip care and discuss individualized hydration goals
- **B.** Avoid all mouth care
- **C.** Force large volumes of water orally
- **D.** Give food despite inability to swallow

<details><summary>Answer aur explanation dekho</summary>

**Correct: A. Provide frequent safe oral and lip care and discuss individualized hydration goals**

**A kyun sahi hai:** Nurse alertness aur swallowing assess karke lips aur mouth ko gently moist rakhti hai. Agar patient safely swallow kar sake toh suitable sips offer kar sakti hai. Hydration ke benefits aur risks patient aur team ke saath discuss kiye jaate hain.

**B kyun galat hai:** Mouth care band karne se dryness aur discomfort badh sakte hain. Safe mouth care abhi bhi useful hai.

**C kyun galat hai:** Swallowing weak ho toh force karke paani pilane se liquid airway mein ja sakta hai. Isko aspiration kehte hain aur isse breathing ki problem ho sakti hai.

**D kyun galat hai:** Patient swallow nahi kar paa raha hai toh food dene se choking aur aspiration ka risk badhta hai. Feeding assessment aur care goals ke according honi chahiye.

**Exam clue:** Dry mouth mein safe oral comfort care do aur hydration individualize karo.

**Evidence and links:** Preserve the current mock metadata and references. Review source-bank evidence for appropriate qualified propagation only after coordination.

</details>

### Q81. A patient near end of life has distressing breathlessness despite an initial plan. What should the nurse do?

Source bank Q7.

- **A.** Insist on vigorous exercise
- **B.** Give an unprescribed sedative dose without assessment
- **C.** Assess symptoms and reversible contributors, provide comfort measures and request symptom-treatment review
- **D.** Assume breathlessness must remain untreated

<details><summary>Answer aur explanation dekho</summary>

**Correct: C. Assess symptoms and reversible contributors, provide comfort measures and request symptom-treatment review**

**A kyun galat hai:** Vigorous exercise se oxygen demand badh sakti hai aur already breathless patient ko aur takleef ho sakti hai. Activity tolerance aur goals ke according honi chahiye.

**B kyun galat hai:** Unprescribed sedative se consciousness aur breathing affect ho sakti hai. Nurse assessment ke bina medicine administer nahi karti.

**C kyun sahi hai:** Nurse breathlessness ki severity, breathing effort aur possible reversible causes assess karti hai. Comfortable positioning aur calm support se relief mil sakta hai. Treating team se prescribed symptom plan review karwati hai aur acute deterioration mein agreed emergency plan ke according urgent help leti hai.

**D kyun galat hai:** Palliative care ka matlab distress ko untreated chhodna nahi hai. Breathlessness ke liye comfort aur appropriate treatment dono consider karte hain.

**Exam clue:** Breathlessness mein assessment, comfort aur cause-directed review saath chalte hain.

**Evidence and links:** Preserve the current mock metadata and references. Review source-bank evidence for appropriate qualified propagation only after coordination.

</details>

### Q96. Which nursing action maintains dignity when providing personal care to a dying patient?

Source bank Q8.

- **A.** Ignore expressed spiritual needs
- **B.** Discuss the patient as if absent even when conscious
- **C.** Expose the body unnecessarily
- **D.** Explain care, protect privacy and respect the person's preferences

<details><summary>Answer aur explanation dekho</summary>

**Correct: D. Explain care, protect privacy and respect the person's preferences**

**A kyun galat hai:** Spiritual needs ignore karne se patient ka comfort aur trust affect ho sakta hai. Nurse poochti hai ki patient ko kis tarah ka support chahiye.

**B kyun galat hai:** Conscious patient ke saamne usko ignore karke baat karna disrespectful ho sakta hai. Nurse patient ko discussion mein shamil karti hai jitna woh chahe aur kar sake.

**C kyun galat hai:** Bina zaroorat body expose karne se privacy compromise hoti hai. Nurse sirf required area expose karti hai.

**D kyun sahi hai:** Dying patient bhi dignity aur respect ka haq rakhta hai. Nurse care se pehle samjhati hai, privacy maintain karti hai, applicable consent process follow karti hai aur patient ki preferences ko care mein include karti hai.

**Exam clue:** Dignity mein privacy, respectful communication aur patient preference important hain.

**Evidence and links:** Preserve the current mock metadata and references. Review source-bank evidence for appropriate qualified propagation only after coordination.

Source bank Q11.

- **A.** Medication reconciliation
- **B.** Financial auditing
- **C.** Mandatory religious conversion

**Correct: D. Spiritual support**

**B kyun galat hai:** Financial auditing accounts aur expenses check karne se related hai. Requested counselor visit ka purpose emotional ya spiritual support ho sakta hai.

**C kyun galat hai:** Patient ki permission ke bina beliefs impose karna spiritual care nahi hai. Nurse patient ke apne beliefs aur choices ka respect karti hai.

**D kyun sahi hai:** Spiritual support mein patient ke beliefs, life ke meaning aur hope jaise concerns ko respect karte hain. Agar patient counselor ya religious representative se milna chahta hai, toh nurse uski choice ke according access arrange kar sakti hai.

### Q47. A patient has a documented do-not-attempt-resuscitation order. Which interpretation is correct?

Source bank Q9.

- **A.** It authorizes staff to ignore every acute symptom
- **B.** It means all medicines must stop immediately
- **C.** It limits CPR according to the order but does not automatically stop other appropriate care
- **D.** It prohibits pain relief and nursing care

<details><summary>Answer aur explanation dekho</summary>

**Correct: C. It limits CPR according to the order but does not automatically stop other appropriate care**

**A kyun galat hai:** DNAR hone par bhi nurse new symptoms assess karti hai aur agreed plan ke according action leti hai. Symptoms ignore karna order ka meaning nahi hai.

**B kyun galat hai:** Saari medicines automatically band karne se untreated symptoms ya reversible problems worsen ho sakti hain. Medicine review ke liye alag authorized decision chahiye.

**C kyun sahi hai:** DNAR ka matlab Do Not Attempt Resuscitation hai. Valid DNAR order cardiac ya respiratory arrest ke samay CPR ke decision se related hai. Pain relief, nursing care aur doosra suitable treatment alag clinical plan ke according jaari reh sakta hai.

**D kyun galat hai:** Pain relief aur comfort care DNAR ke saath bhi important hain. Patient ki dignity aur takleef kam karne ki responsibility bani rehti hai.

**Exam clue:** DNAR CPR ko address karta hai, do not treat ka order nahi hai.

**Evidence and links:** Preserve the current mock metadata and references. Review source-bank evidence for appropriate qualified propagation only after coordination.

</details>

### Q62. A family demands CPR despite a valid documented plan and the patient's previously expressed wishes. What should the nurse do?

Source bank Q10.

- **A.** Argue with the family at the bedside
- **B.** Change the order independently
- **C.** Follow applicable policy and authorized plan and seek immediate senior clinical support for the conflict
- **D.** Ignore the documented wishes without review

<details><summary>Answer aur explanation dekho</summary>

**Correct: C. Follow applicable policy and authorized plan and seek immediate senior clinical support for the conflict**

**A kyun galat hai:** Bedside par argument karne se family ka distress badh sakta hai. Calm explanation aur senior support se conflict safely handle hota hai.

**B kyun galat hai:** Nurse apne level par DNAR order cancel ya replace nahi kar sakti. Aise decision ke liye authorized clinician aur applicable consent process chahiye.

**C kyun sahi hai:** Nurse valid documented plan aur applicable policy check karti hai aur senior treating team ko turant involve karti hai. Family ki concern compassion se sunti hai. Agar order ki validity unclear ho, toh urgent clarification aur local emergency protocol follow karna zaroori hai.

**D kyun galat hai:** Patient ki documented wishes bina review ignore karna autonomy aur safety compromise kar sakta hai. Authorized team order ki validity aur relevance confirm karti hai.

**Exam clue:** Valid plan par conflict ho toh senior clinical support lo aur applicable policy follow karo.

**Evidence and links:** Preserve the current mock metadata and references. Review source-bank evidence for appropriate qualified propagation only after coordination.

</details>

### Q64. A terminally ill patient says, I do not want my family informed about this detail. What is the appropriate response?

Source bank Q12.

- **A.** Publish the detail in a public area
- **B.** Inform family automatically against the patient's wishes
- **C.** Promise secrecy even where disclosure is legally required
- **D.** Explore the preference, protect confidentiality and discuss communication within applicable law

<details><summary>Answer aur explanation dekho</summary>

**Correct: D. Explore the preference, protect confidentiality and discuss communication within applicable law**

**A kyun galat hai:** Public area mein private medical information publish karna confidentiality breach hai. Information appropriate authorized logon tak limited rehni chahiye.

**B kyun galat hai:** Family hone se har medical detail ka automatic access nahi milta. Patient ki valid preference aur lawful exceptions check karne chahiye.

**C kyun galat hai:** Nurse har situation mein absolute secrecy promise nahi kar sakti. Law ya immediate safety ke hisaab se authorized disclosure zaroori ho sakta hai.

**D kyun sahi hai:** Nurse patient se poochti hai ki woh kya information share karna chahta hai aur kis se. Capacity, consent aur confidentiality ka respect karti hai. Lawful exception ho toh authorized team se guidance leti hai.

**Exam clue:** Confidentiality protect karo aur lawful exceptions ke baare mein false promise mat karo.

**Evidence and links:** Preserve the current mock metadata and references. Review source-bank evidence for appropriate qualified propagation only after coordination.

### Q33. A patient with advanced disease develops new severe pain that is different from the usual symptoms. What should the nurse do?

Source bank Q15.

- **A.** Repeat all previous doses without checking timing
- **B.** Avoid documenting because the patient is receiving palliation
- **C.** Assume all pain is inevitable and ignore it
- **D.** Assess promptly for new causes and seek appropriate review consistent with care goals

<details><summary>Answer aur explanation dekho</summary>

**Correct: D. Assess promptly for new causes and seek appropriate review consistent with care goals**

**A kyun galat hai:** Previous doses bina timing, prescription aur response check kiye repeat karne se adverse effects ya overdose ho sakta hai. Nurse authorized medicine plan follow karti hai.

**B kyun galat hai:** Documentation se next nurse aur team ko symptoms, intervention aur response pata chalta hai. Palliative status documentation ki responsibility khatam nahi karta.

**C kyun galat hai:** Pain ko inevitable kehkar ignore karne se avoidable suffering aur new complication miss ho sakti hai. Palliation mein bhi assessment zaroori hai.

**D kyun sahi hai:** New severe pain ko purane pain ka hissa maan lena unsafe hai. Nurse onset, site, severity, associated symptoms aur prior treatment response assess karti hai. Agreed goals ke hisaab se prompt clinical review arrange karke symptom relief aur new cause dono consider karti hai.

**Exam clue:** New severe symptom ko promptly assess karo aur care goals ke according review lo.

**Evidence and links:** Preserve the current mock metadata and references. Review source-bank evidence for appropriate qualified propagation only after coordination.

### Q90. Which action is appropriate after a patient's death once required verification and instructions are complete?

Source bank Q16.

- **A.** Provide respectful care of the body and follow identification, cultural and facility procedures
- **B.** Ignore family preferences regardless of feasibility
- **C.** Discard belongings without documentation
- **D.** Remove identification tags immediately without authorization

<details><summary>Answer aur explanation dekho</summary>

**Correct: A. Provide respectful care of the body and follow identification, cultural and facility procedures**

**A kyun sahi hai:** Required death verification aur instructions complete hone ke baad nurse body ko dignity se handle karti hai. Correct identification, infection precautions, belongings documentation aur cultural preferences ko facility policy ke according manage karti hai.

**B kyun galat hai:** Family ki cultural ya religious preferences feasible aur lawful hon toh respect karni chahiye. Unsafe ya prohibited request ko nurse respectfully explain karti hai.

**C kyun galat hai:** Belongings family ke liye important ho sakte hain. Unko record, secure aur policy ke hisaab se handover karna chahiye.

**D kyun galat hai:** Identification tags bina authorization hatane se body ki identity confirm karna mushkil ho sakta hai. Nurse facility ki identification procedure follow karti hai.

**Exam clue:** After-death care mein dignity, correct identification aur legal procedure zaroori hain.

**Evidence and links:** Preserve the current mock metadata and references. Review source-bank evidence for appropriate qualified propagation only after coordination.

### Q101. A family asks why the dying patient is eating less. Which response is most appropriate?

Source bank Q14.

- **A.** Promise appetite will return within hours
- **B.** Stop every oral comfort intervention automatically
- **C.** Force feeding to reach the previous calorie target regardless of distress
- **D.** Explain that appetite and swallowing may decline and discuss comfort-focused feeding and safety

<details><summary>Answer aur explanation dekho</summary>

**Correct: D. Explain that appetite and swallowing may decline and discuss comfort-focused feeding and safety**

**A kyun galat hai:** Nurse appetite return hone ka exact time guarantee nahi kar sakti. Patient ki condition aur goals ke according realistic explanation deti hai.

**B kyun galat hai:** Oral comfort automatically stop karna zaroori nahi hai. Safe mouth care aur preferred sips assessment ke hisaab se continue ho sakte hain.

**C kyun galat hai:** Force feeding se discomfort, choking ya aspiration ho sakti hai. Purana calorie target har situation mein appropriate nahi hota.

**D kyun sahi hai:** Dying phase mein appetite aur swallowing ability change ho sakti hain. Nurse family ko simple words mein samjhati hai ki goal comfort ho sakta hai. Patient ki wish, alertness aur aspiration risk dekhkar suitable feeding ya mouth care discuss karti hai.

**Exam clue:** End-of-life feeding mein comfort, consent aur swallowing safety priority hain.

**Evidence and links:** Preserve the current mock metadata and references. Review source-bank evidence for appropriate qualified propagation only after coordination.

</details>

### Q119. What is the purpose of advance care planning?

Source bank Q13.

- **A.** Guarantee an identical treatment plan for all patients
- **B.** Discuss future care values and preferences before decisions become difficult
- **C.** Replace assessment of current capacity
- **D.** Require immediate withdrawal of treatment

<details><summary>Answer aur explanation dekho</summary>

**Correct: B. Discuss future care values and preferences before decisions become difficult**

**A kyun galat hai:** Har patient ke beliefs, illness aur priorities alag hain. Ek identical plan sab par apply nahi hota.

**B kyun sahi hai:** Advance care planning mein patient pehle discuss kar sakta hai ki future mein illness badhne par kaunsi care aur values uske liye important hongi. Nurse discussion aur documentation support karti hai. Plan present wishes, clinical condition aur applicable law ke according review hota hai.

**C kyun galat hai:** Advance plan hone par bhi jab patient current decision le sakta hai, toh uski present choice aur capacity relevant hoti hai. Purana plan assessment replace nahi karta.

**D kyun galat hai:** Advance care planning ka matlab treatment turant withdraw karna nahi hai. Yeh future decisions ke liye patient ke goals samajhne ka process hai.

**Exam clue:** Advance care planning future preferences ka discussion hai, automatic withdrawal nahi.

**Evidence and links:** Preserve the current mock metadata and references. Review source-bank evidence for appropriate qualified propagation only after coordination.

### Q17. A death may require medicolegal investigation. What should the nurse do before removing lines or altering the body?

Source bank Q17.

- **A.** Discard the clinical record
- **B.** Wash away all potentially relevant material
- **C.** Remove every device immediately by default
- **D.** Follow applicable legal and institutional directions and preserve potential evidence

<details><summary>Answer aur explanation dekho</summary>

**Correct: D. Follow applicable legal and institutional directions and preserve potential evidence**

**A kyun galat hai:** Clinical record se patient ki condition aur interventions ka timeline pata chalta hai. Use discard karna inappropriate hai aur record retention rules violate kar sakta hai.

**B kyun galat hai:** Potential evidence wash karne se investigation ke liye relevant material lose ho sakta hai. Nurse required direction milne tak unnecessary alteration avoid karti hai.

**C kyun galat hai:** Medicolegal investigation mein tubes ya lines important evidence ho sakti hain. Bina authorized direction unko nikalne se evidence disturb ho sakta hai.

**D kyun sahi hai:** Jab death investigation ke under aa sakti hai, toh nurse authorized senior aur relevant institutional process ko inform karti hai. Body, lines aur potential evidence ko prescribed procedure ke according preserve karti hai aur required documentation maintain karti hai.

**Exam clue:** Medicolegal case mein routine after-death care se pehle authorized instructions check karo.

**Evidence and links:** Preserve the current mock metadata and references. Review source-bank evidence for appropriate qualified propagation only after coordination.

### Q23. Which intervention can support a family during bedside end-of-life care?

Source bank Q18.

- **A.** Provide contradictory information without clarification
- **B.** Guarantee an exact time of death
- **C.** Exclude the family regardless of the patient's wishes
- **D.** Offer clear updates, space for questions and opportunities for appropriate participation

<details><summary>Answer aur explanation dekho</summary>

**Correct: D. Offer clear updates, space for questions and opportunities for appropriate participation**

**A kyun galat hai:** Contradictory updates confusion aur anxiety badha sakte hain. Team se clarification lekar consistent information deni chahiye.

**B kyun galat hai:** Death ka exact time reliably predict karna generally possible nahi hai. Nurse expected changes samjha sakti hai, lekin false guarantee nahi deti.

**C kyun galat hai:** Family ko har situation mein exclude karna patient ki preference ke against ho sakta hai. Involvement patient consent, privacy aur safety ke according decide hoti hai.

**D kyun sahi hai:** Nurse family ko understandable updates deti hai, questions sunti hai aur uncertainty honestly explain karti hai. Patient ki permission aur clinical safety ke hisaab se family bedside presence ya simple care mein participate kar sakti hai.

**Exam clue:** Family support mein clear updates aur patient-approved participation important hain.

**Evidence and links:** Preserve the current mock metadata and references. Review source-bank evidence for appropriate qualified propagation only after coordination.

### Q60. A nurse feels emotionally overwhelmed after repeated patient deaths. Which professional response is appropriate?

Source bank Q20.

- **A.** Ignore distress until care quality deteriorates
- **B.** Share identifiable patient details publicly
- **C.** Seek supervision or peer support and use appropriate well-being resources while maintaining confidentiality
- **D.** Assume asking for support is always unprofessional

<details><summary>Answer aur explanation dekho</summary>

**Correct: C. Seek supervision or peer support and use appropriate well-being resources while maintaining confidentiality**

**A kyun galat hai:** Distress ignore karte rehne se concentration aur care quality affect ho sakti hai. Timely help lene se patient safety aur nurse ki health dono protect hoti hain.

**B kyun galat hai:** Identifiable patient details public mein share karna confidentiality breach hai. Support ke liye appropriate confidential setting use karni chahiye.

**C kyun sahi hai:** Repeated patient deaths se nurse emotionally affected ho sakti hai. Nurse confidential supervision, peer support ya occupational well-being resources use karti hai. Agar distress care dene ki ability affect kare, toh senior ko inform karke safe support arrange karna professional responsibility hai.

**D kyun galat hai:** Support maangna unprofessional nahi hai. Apni limits recognize karna aur safe care ke liye help lena accountability ka part hai.

**Exam clue:** Confidential professional support nurse well-being aur patient safety ka part hai.

**Evidence and links:** Preserve the current mock metadata and references. Review source-bank evidence for appropriate qualified propagation only after coordination.

</details>

### Q79. A bereaved person reports inability to manage daily activities and expresses thoughts of self-harm. What is the priority?

Source bank Q19.

- **A.** Dismiss the concern because a loss occurred recently
- **B.** Assess immediate safety and arrange urgent mental health support
- **C.** Ask the person to remain alone indefinitely
- **D.** Treat the statement as ordinary grief requiring no assessment

<details><summary>Answer aur explanation dekho</summary>

**Correct: B. Assess immediate safety and arrange urgent mental health support**

**A kyun galat hai:** Recent loss distress explain kar sakta hai, lekin self-harm thoughts ko harmless nahi banata. Nurse concern seriously leti hai.

**B kyun sahi hai:** Self-harm ki baat aur daily functioning mein severe difficulty immediate safety assessment maangti hai. Nurse calmly direct safety questions poochti hai, suitable support arrange karti hai aur urgent mental health ya emergency team ko involve karti hai. Immediate danger ho toh person ko akela nahi chhodna chahiye.

**C kyun galat hai:** Person ko indefinitely akela rakhne se support nahi milta. Immediate risk mein appropriate supervision aur urgent help chahiye.

**D kyun galat hai:** Ordinary grief mein sadness ho sakti hai, lekin self-harm thoughts ko bina assessment normal declare karna unsafe hai. Safety aur support ka plan zaroori hai.

**Exam clue:** Grief ke saath self-harm thoughts aayein toh safety assessment aur urgent support priority hain.
